thread:
Aisha: Flagging a problem we hit in staging: the role-migration preview page tries to render a diffs heatmap for a tenant with 12k affected routes and the browser OOMs. Need a plan before we enable migration for enterprise customers.
Tom: Can you repro steps + a heap snapshot? I can probably throttle rendering.
Aisha: Steps: Select 'Migrate roles' -> choose baseline role R1 -> preview diff. The preview attempts to load per-route permission deltas and the heatmap tiles for every route.
Priya: Telemetry shows preview_load.lat p95 jumping from 600ms -> 8.3s and console.render_errors increased. Also observed `perm.diff_rows` ~12000.
telemetry-bot: alert: preview_load.lat.p95 for tenant t-enterprise-5 breached threshold at 1802110000.
Alex (Console): UX proposal: don't hydrate full diff client-side. Show a summarized heatmap (buckets by route prefix + severity) and lazy-load details for hovered buckets. Provide an "Export full diff CSV" for auditors.
Tom: Backend changes: add an aggregated diff endpoint that returns buckets + counts instead of full row list. Keep full-diff behind a stream endpoint that pages. That avoids sending 12k rows in one payload.
Priya: Also add a sampling flag for telemetry: when preview rows > 1k, sample 10% of rows for detailed metrics and always include top 20 by impact. Emit metric `preview.sampled=true`.
Aisha: For safety, require an opt-in checkbox for migrations that affect >5k routes and show an estimated quota/write burn. Admins were surprised by the mutation volume.
Alex (Console): UX microcopy: "This migration affects ~12,000 endpoints. We recommend reviewing the summary view. Export full details for audit or enable full preview." Add a prominent Export button.
Tom: Rollout: implement aggregated endpoint + streaming pages, then flip console to use aggregated for any tenant with >1000 diff rows. Feature flag `console.migrate_preview_agg` for canary.
Priya: Metrics to track: preview_load_time, preview_export_count, migration_accept_rate_after_preview, preview.sampled_ratio, preview.heap_errors. Set an alert if accept_rate drops >10% in canary.
telemetry-bot: note: scheduled deploy of migration-preview v3 (adds aggregation + sampling) -> canary 2024-12-02T08:00Z.
Aisha: Action items: Tom (agg endpoint + stream), Priya (telemetry sampling + panels), Alex (summary heatmap mock + export button), I'll draft the RFC with the safety checkbox language.
Tom: I'll start the backend patch and add streaming tests.
Alex (Console): Mock uploaded: https://figma.com/s/migration-summary-heatmap (private).
Aisha: Thanks all, let's reconvene after canary metrics. :white_check_mark:
